description: Explore the baffling disappearance of explorer Percy Fawcett and the clues that still intrigue investigators.

facts.claim: Percy Fawcett disappeared in March 1925 near the Rio Negro while searching for the Lost City of Z.
In July 1925, local indigenous people reported hearing gunshots and seeing a solitary tent amid fog near the expedition area.
A 1932 rescue expedition found only footprints and a broken compass near the river, with no sign of the party.
Satellite imagery analysis published in 2023 identified a cleared area matching the coordinates described in Fawcett's notes.
